title: Multipath output assertor and CI smoke suite for interleaved tool routes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Build a lightweight, reproducible smoke suite and an assertor harness that verifies correctness of interleaved streaming outputs when models invoke tools/function-calls and emit structured payloads. The goal is to catch API-level regressions early in PRs (fast smoke) and nightly runs (deeper scenarios) that would otherwise surface as customer-facing corruption of toolcall payloads, out-of-order chunks, or JSON reassembly failures.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic smoke CI job that runs in under 3 minutes on PRs and fails for any change that breaks ordered streaming frames or tool-call boundary semantics

An assertor harness (Multipath Output Assertor, MOA) that can replay recorded interleaved sessions and validate: chunk order, tool-call ID/params fidelity, NDJSON/JSON-roundtrip for structured output, and reconnection semantics
A reference prompt corpus (seed set) covering at least 12 interleaved scenarios including nested tool calls, partial JSON emission, backpressure and reconnects
Nightly regression job that runs extended scenarios with model stubs and real routing fallbacks and produces a triage report with prioritized failures
CI provides clear failure signals and links to repro artifacts (recorded streams, reconstructed payloads, trace IDs)
tasks: Design MOA API: inputs (recorded stream + stubbed tool responses), assertions, and output diffs
Implement minimal stream replayer that supports artificial jitter, reconnects, and chunk reassembly
Create reference prompt corpus (seed set) and label scenarios with expected assertions
Integrate smoke job into GitHub Actions with a stubbed model shim and deterministic seeds
Add nightly job in CI that runs longer scenarios and uploads triage bundle to S3
Write runbook for triage: how to replay failures locally, interpret diffs, and file follow-ups
Coordinate with SDK team for a small shim exposing streaming frames for test-only endpoints
Add telemetry knobs to surface de-serializations errors and first-failure traces to Console dashboard
updates: 2026-03-01: Spike completed. Prototype replayer can take ndjson-like frames and reconstruct message boundaries with simulated latency.
2026-03-04: PM review (Leah Kim) — asked to prioritize PR smoke latency threshold and ensure failures include actionable diffs. Added explicit acceptance for <3 minute PR job.
2026-03-07: Design sync with SDK team. They agreed to add a test-only 'frame_dump' header to endpoints to emit raw streaming frames for the assertor.
2026-03-10: Prototype run against internal model-stub found ordering bug when toolcall responses are emitted across reconnects. Logged as a separate fix (ENG-46861).
2026-03-12: Reviewed approach with Reliability (Jonah Reed). Suggested adding token-level checksum assertions to catch silent byte corruption from kernel changes.
2026-03-14: Implementation plan approved. Next: implement MOA library and wire up PR GitHub Action. Assigned Miguel for engineering work and set estimate to 8 points.
